verdict.rationale: ByteAsk documents an 'auto' model setting in which the tool chooses the model for you, chaining three models across two providers. The documentation describes this only as availability failover, where a turn moves to the next model if one is having a bad day, not as choosing the best model for each task. Missing for 10: evidence of task-aware routing that picks the best model per task, documentation of how auto selects or ranks models, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can let the tool automatically pick the best model for each task

citations.quote: auto is now a chain across three models and two providers rather than a single fixed choice, so if one is having a bad day your turn quietly lands on the next.
